name: Kyle Sandilands (Australian radio host)
description: Australian radio host, shock jock and television personality, born in 1971 in Brisbane. He co-hosted The Kyle and Jackie O Show with Jackie O from 2005 to 2026, first on 2Day FM and later on KIIS 106.5.
key_facts: co-host of The Kyle and Jackie O Show
summary: Kyle Dalton Sandilands (born 10 June 1971, Brisbane) is an Australian radio host, television personality and self-styled "shock jock." He is best known as the male half of The Kyle and Jackie O Show with Jackie O Hender…
